# Upstream camera-conditioning code

This directory preserves the original
[`ripl/CamPoseOpensource`](https://github.com/ripl/CamPoseOpensource) policy,
reproduction, and data-generation utilities. The action-Jacobian experiment
uses selected simulator and data utilities from this directory, but its model,
representation, dataset, training, and evaluation code live at the repository
root and under `src/action_jacobian/`.
